name: Potato Chips
description: Polyphonic chiptune oscillators, FM synth voices, editable wavetables, envelopes, and effects inspired by classic sound chips.
author: Christian Kauten

modules.name: Blocks
modules.description: Four digital oscillators with tonal and stepped-noise waveforms, based on Mutable Instruments Edges.
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro Mutable Instruments Edges sine triangle NES LFSR sample-and-hold

modules.name: Mini Boss
modules.description: Single Yamaha YM2612 FM operator with an envelope, feedback, and external modulation, from the Sega Genesis / Mega Drive.
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro Yamaha YM2612 OPN2 Sega Genesis Mega Drive FM frequency modulation single operator SSG-EG

modules.name: Name Corp Octal Wave Generator
modules.description: Eight Namco 163 wavetable oscillators with five editable waves and morphing, from NES / Famicom cartridges.
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro Namco 163 N163 N106 Nintendo NES Famicom wavetable morphing drawing

modules.name: Boss Fight
modules.description: Four-operator Yamaha YM2612 FM synth voice with eight algorithms and looping envelopes, from the Sega Genesis / Mega Drive.
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro Yamaha YM2612 OPN2 Sega Genesis Mega Drive FM frequency modulation four operator SSG-EG

modules.name: Boss Fight Envelope Generator (Blank)
modules.description: Passive reference panel illustrating the Boss Fight Yamaha YM2612 envelope stages.
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro Yamaha YM2612 OPN2 Sega Genesis Mega Drive ADSR envelope reference diagram

modules.name: Infinite Stairs
modules.description: Two pulse oscillators, triangle, and noise from the Ricoh 2A03 in the Nintendo Entertainment System (NES).
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro Ricoh 2A03 Nintendo NES Famicom APU pulse square triangle PWM duty cycle

modules.name: Jairasullator
modules.description: Three General Instrument AY-3-8910 tone channels with shared noise, looping envelopes, and stepped DAC operation.
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro General Instrument AY-3-8910 AY8910 PSG pulse square DAC amplitude modulation

modules.name: Pulses
modules.description: Three pulse oscillators emulating the Sunsoft FME-7 sound chip from NES / Famicom cartridges.
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro Sunsoft FME-7 FME7 Nintendo NES Famicom pulse square

modules.name: Pallet Town Waves System
modules.description: Game Boy sound system with two pulse oscillators, an editable morphing wavetable, and noise.
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro Nintendo Game Boy Gameboy GB DMG APU pulse square wavetable morphing drawing

modules.name: Pot Keys
modules.description: Four Atari POKEY tone/noise channels with selectable distortion, clock, and high-pass modes.
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro Atari POKEY pulse square LFSR polynomial distortion high-pass

modules.name: Super ADSR
modules.description: Two envelope generators based on the Sony S-DSP in the Super Nintendo Entertainment System (SNES).
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro Sony S-DSP SDSP SNES Super Nintendo Super Famicom ADSR attack decay sustain release

modules.name: Super Echo
modules.description: Stereo Sony S-DSP echo with feedback and an eight-tap FIR filter, from the Super Nintendo Entertainment System (SNES).
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro Sony S-DSP SDSP SNES Super Nintendo Super Famicom stereo echo FIR feedback comb

modules.name: Super VCA
modules.description: Two Sony S-DSP-style Gaussian interpolation filters and VCAs with signed gain and 8-bit input quantization.
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro Sony S-DSP SDSP SNES Super Nintendo Super Famicom Gaussian interpolation stereo quantization

modules.name: S-SMP Blank
modules.description: Passive panel illustrating the Sony S-SMP sound CPU from the Super Nintendo Entertainment System (SNES).
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro Sony S-SMP SSMP SPC700 SNES Super Nintendo Super Famicom chip illustration

modules.name: Mega Tone
modules.description: Three pulse oscillators and periodic/white noise from the Texas Instruments SN76489 in the Sega Master System and Genesis.
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro Texas Instruments TI SN76489 PSG Sega Master System Mega Drive Genesis pulse square LFSR

modules.name: Step Saw
modules.description: Two pulse oscillators and a stepped sawtooth from the Konami VRC6 sound chip in NES / Famicom cartridges.
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro Konami VRC6 Nintendo NES Famicom pulse square sawtooth PWM duty cycle
